run_chess_ai_demo: run a chess game demo where Gemini and OpenAI models play moves against each other
run_demo_with_custom_models: run the chess harness demo with custom gemini and openai model flags
run_demo_with_num_moves: run the chess harness demo for a specified number of moves using the num_moves flag
review_main_orchestration: review the main function that orchestrates prompt generation, model calls, parsing, and move application
review_chained_move_parser: review the ChainedMoveParser that chains RuleBasedMoveParser and ChessSoftParser to parse model responses
